decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the extensions are occupied.
Condition : 4 - The extensions hereby permitted shall not be occupied at any time other than for purposes ancillary to the residential use of the dwellings known as 314 and 316 Heston Road.

Condition : 5 - No additional flank windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the northern or southern walls of the extension hereby approved without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 6 - The roof area of the extension hereby permitted shall not be used as a balcony, roof garden or similar amenity area without the grant of further specific permission from the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 7 - The parking spaces shown on drawings submiktted 24 May 2005  shall be provided before the extensions hereby approved are first occupied and thereafter shall not be used for any purpose other than the parking of vehicles and shall be permanently retained

Condition : 8 - No development shall take place until full details of landscaping works for the proposed front garden areas have been submitted to and approved by the local planning authority and these works shall be carried out as approved before occupation and the area shall not be subsequently laid out to hardstanding.

Condition : 9 - The respective parts of the development at 314 and 316 Heston Road shall be carried out concurrently and all parts of the development shall be completed in full within two years of the commencement of the development.

Condition : 10 - It is considered that the proposed extensions, would be acceptable due to their position, design and appearance. The development would not harm the appearance of the area, neighbours' living conditions or highway safety and complies with policies ENV-B.1.1 (New Development), H.6.4 (Extensions and Alterations) and 1.4 (Car and Cycle Parking and Servicing Facilities for Developments) of The London Borough of Hounslow Unitary Development Plan.
description: Erection of two storey side extensions and part two/part single storey rear extensions and roof extensions to both houses.
